name: Named Entity Recognition
problem_statement: We operate a market intelligence platform and need NER and entity disambiguation tools, models, and techniques that work well on news-like text for entity types including companies, places, people, and products.
objective: Improve Precision, Recall, and F1 scores for named entity recognition and disambiguation on news-style content across entity types such as companies, places, people, and products.

domain.application: News content processing and entity extraction

performance_criteria.target: improvement over baseline on news-like content
improvement over baseline on news-like content
improvement over baseline on news-like content

must_have: Paper addresses NER or entity disambiguation on news or newswire-style text
Paper reports Precision, Recall, or F1 metrics
Paper presents or evaluates an NER or entity disambiguation method (includes cross-lingual, low-resource, or domain-transfer settings where the technique is applicable to news-style text)
nice_to_have: Covers multiple entity types (companies, people, places, products)
Benchmarks on standard news NER datasets (e.g. CoNLL, OntoNotes)
exclusions: Purely biomedical or clinical NER with no transferable technique (e.g. gene/protein entity recognition only, no general NER method)
Papers that do not address NER or entity disambiguation as a primary task (e.g. general NLP fine-tuning surveys that only mention NER in passing)
